periodEnd: Mon, Nov 23, 2026, 4:00 PM ET (that day's close)
timezoneNote: All times below are shown in ET (America/New_York). Items marked headline were written only from the publisher's headline and summary.

driver.text: Per Bloomberg, US stocks staged a stunning rally, bouncing back from last week's technology-led selloff as the surprise return of Jensen Huang to lead Nvidia propelled Wall Street to its best day since April 2025 (4:42 PM ET). The Financial Times reported the Nasdaq jumped 7% and the S&P 500 rose 4.7% (5:01 PM ET); WSJ reported the Nasdaq composite added more than $2 trillion in market value (4:45 PM ET). MarketWatch called it the best day for US stocks in more than a year (4:51 PM ET). WSJ reported Treasury yields rose as investors piled into riskier assets (4:15 PM ET), and gold settled 3.9% higher after its steepest weekly decline since March (3:21 PM ET). Written from headlines and publisher summaries only.

cryptoDriver.text: The Block reported Grayscale said bitcoin and major altcoins look 'oversold' as AI risks cloud the near-term outlook, and that bitcoin's weekend drop made the current bear market its longest on record (5:18 PM ET). CoinDesk reported bitcoin rebounded from a two-year low as Wall Street futures recovered (6:51 AM ET). Written from headlines and publisher summaries only.

items.headline: Nvidia 8-K: board reinstates Jen-Hsun Huang as President, CEO and director
items.summary: In an 8-K (Items 5.02 and 9.01) accepted Nov 23 at 8:57 AM ET, Nvidia disclosed that on Nov 22, 2026 its Board of Directors reinstated Jen-Hsun Huang as President, Chief Executive Officer and a member of the Board, effective immediately. Colette Kress continues as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. A press release dated Nov 23, 2026 is attached as Exhibit 99.1.

items.headline: Nvidia Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
items.summary: Per WSJ, President Trump acknowledged involvement in efforts to bring back the chip maker's longtime leader, who had resigned following revelations of extramarital affairs. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Nvidia gains nearly $1tn in value after Jensen Huang reinstated
items.summary: Per the Financial Times, the interim chief and senior management were unaware of the discussions over the weekend. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Nasdaq jumps 7% as Nvidia shares soar
items.summary: Per the Financial Times, the chip giant gained 31.5% after Huang was reinstated while the S&P 500 rose 4.7%. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Short sellers get smoked as Nvidia tallies biggest one-day gain in stock-market history
items.summary: Per MarketWatch, two products aiming to profit off daily declines in Nvidia shares were nearly wiped out as the stock rallied more than 30%. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: US Blacklists Megaspeed, Targeting a Key Player in Nvidia Crisis
items.summary: Per Bloomberg, the Trump administration put Megaspeed International on a US trade blacklist barring it from buying advanced artificial intelligence chips, targeting a Singapore-based firm at the heart of the scandal that briefly cost Jensen Huang his job as Nvidia chief executive officer. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Jensen Huang's Return to Nvidia Draws Heavy Fire From Lawmakers
items.summary: Per WSJ, Republicans and Democrats see national-security risks and are vowing to press forward with investigations. The Financial Times separately reported that lawmakers insist Huang must testify in public (2:11 PM ET). Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Jensen Huang Is Back at Nvidia. Major Investigations Still Surround Him.
items.summary: Per WSJ, several probes are examining the chip maker, its CEO and issues related to his initial ouster. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.
